name: zameen-ai-agent
description: Vectara-powered conversational property search over Zameen.com Karachi listings

scripts.bootstrap: npm run scrape && npm run normalize && npm run setup:vectara
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run -w @zameen/server dev" "npm run -w @zameen/web dev"
scripts.build: npm run -w @zameen/shared build && npm run -w @zameen/server build && npm run -w @zameen/web build
